title: Motor Current
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the motor current as 3 A, recognizing it equals the series resistor current.

title: Input Power
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the electrical power input to the motor as 360 W using P = I * V.

title: Output Power
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the mechanical output power as 351 W by subtracting Joule heating from input power.

title: Object Mass
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the mass of the object as 35.1 kg using P_motor = m * g * v.

title: Circuit Analysis
description: Important: Applies series circuit logic to find voltage across R and current through it.

title: Motor Power Balance
description: Important: Recognizes that motor output power equals input power minus internal resistive losses.

title: Mechanical Power Relation
description: Important: Connects mechanical output power to lifting work via P = F*v = m*g*v.

title: Sign/Unit Error
description: Pitfall: Makes sign errors in voltage loop or uses incorrect units in power/force calculations.

title: Ignoring Internal Loss
description: Pitfall: Equates motor input power directly to mechanical output power, ignoring internal resistance heating.
